question: Avodemia avocado oil company owner parent brand
markdown:
Avodemia is an independent Kenyan agribusiness and avocado processing company
. It was co-founded by
Shiine Yusuf
, who serves as the Group Chief Executive Officer. The company operates under its primary corporate entities,
Avodemia Ltd
Avodemia International
, headquartered near Ruiru Town (Exit 11 off Thika Road) in Kiambu County, Kenya, with no larger multinational parent conglomerate publicly listed.

Core Operations:
Processing fresh Hass and Fuerte avocados into crude and cold-pressed oil for the food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries.

(Co-Founder & Group CEO)

Operates privately as Avodemia Ltd / Avodemia International without a separate parent corporation.
